tables.name: chat_run
tables.comment: 一轮问答执行与幂等记录

tables.name: document_access_grant
tables.comment: 文档跨部门用户或部门共享

tables.name: document_chunk
tables.comment: 分块正文与 1024 维向量

tables.name: evaluation_result
tables.comment: 评估执行中的逐题结果

tables.name: graph_projection
tables.comment: Neo4j 图谱投影构建记录

tables.name: knowledge_base_grant
tables.comment: 知识库用户或部门授权

tables.name: outbox_event
tables.comment: 事务内创建的待投递事件

columns.name: citation_no
columns.comment: 对应 S1 等引用序号

columns.name: document_id
columns.comment: 来源文档，保留元数据外键

columns.name: source_generation_id
columns.comment: 来源索引批次快照，允许批次后续清理

columns.name: source_chunk_id
columns.comment: 来源 chunk ID 快照，不阻止 chunk 清理

columns.name: content_sha256
columns.comment: 证据正文哈希，用于核对

columns.name: actor_member_id
columns.comment: 操作者；系统事件可为空

columns.name: target_id
columns.comment: 目标标识快照，不受业务对象删除影响

columns.name: session_key
columns.comment: 令牌携带的随机会话标识

columns.name: refresh_token_hash
columns.comment: Refresh Token 的 SHA-256 摘要

columns.name: lease_epoch
columns.comment: 执行租约代次，领取时递增

columns.name: payload
columns.comment: 最小任务参数，不包含凭据

columns.name: execution_snapshot
columns.comment: 查询计划、模型配置与授权版本快照；不能作为实时授权依据

columns.name: model_name
columns.comment: 生成模型，纯结构化回答可为空

columns.name: summary
columns.comment: 摘要内容，使用前仍需检查来源权限

columns.name: parent_id
columns.comment: 父部门，同租户；多级环路由服务层检查

columns.name: confidentiality
columns.comment: 密级：0 内部公开、1 部门内部、2 机密；默认最严格

columns.name: business_status
columns.comment: 业务状态，与索引状态独立

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: 可扩展元数据，授权字段使用显式列

columns.name: kb_id
columns.comment: 知识库，服务于检索过滤

columns.name: embedding_content
columns.comment: 向量化的实际输入，含必要结构上下文

columns.name: embedding
columns.comment: 向量，构建期间可为空，发布前完整性校验要求非空

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: 表格位置等来源元数据

columns.name: object_key
columns.comment: 项目/租户/知识库/文档/修订范围内对象键

columns.name: model_revision
columns.comment: 供应商版本或本地快照版本

columns.name: dimensions
columns.comment: 当前 SQL 的向量维度固定 1024

columns.name: distance_metric
columns.comment: 与当前 HNSW operator class 一致

columns.name: config
columns.comment: 请求配置快照，不保存 API Key

columns.name: expected_evidence
columns.comment: 期望证据 ID/修订的快照数组

columns.name: kb_id
columns.comment: 首期一个数据集对应一个知识库

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 草稿可编辑，冻结版本供评估

columns.name: dataset_id
columns.comment: 数据集版本，保障运行与题目一致

columns.name: code_revision
columns.comment: 代码提交号或发布版本

columns.name: config_snapshot
columns.comment: 模型、索引、权限范围与参数快照，禁止密钥

columns.name: generation_no
columns.comment: 文档内递增构建批次号

columns.name: first_published_at
columns.comment: 首次发布记录，当前发布由 document 指针决定

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: 授权用户，与 department_id 恰选一个

columns.name: code
columns.comment: 租户稳定代码，例如 DEFAULT

columns.name: auth_version
columns.comment: 租户授权版本，权限变更时递增

columns.name: clearance
columns.comment: 密级：0 内部公开、1 部门内部、2 机密

columns.name: email
columns.comment: 已规范化为小写的邮箱

columns.name: password_hash
columns.comment: 密码哈希，禁止存储明文密码

constraints.name: background_task_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (revision_id IS NULL OR document_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: background_task_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (generation_id IS NULL OR revision_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: background_task_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((task_type::text <> ALL (ARRAY['INDEX'::character varying, 'GRAPH'::character varying]::text[])) OR document_id IS NOT NULL AND revision_id IS NOT NULL AND generation_id IS NOT NULL AND chat_session_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: background_task_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (task_type::text <> 'SUMMARY'::text OR chat_session_id IS NOT NULL AND document_id IS NULL AND revision_id IS NULL AND generation_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: background_task_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = 'RUNNING'::text AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch > 0 OR status::text <> 'RUNNING'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)

constraints.name: background_task_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status::text = ANY (ARRAY['SUCCEEDED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying]::text[])) = (finished_at IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: background_task_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'RUNNING'::character varying, 'RETRY_WAIT'::character varying, 'SUCCEEDED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: background_task_task_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (task_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['INDEX'::character varying, 'GRAPH'::character varying, 'SUMMARY'::character varying, 'CLEANUP'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: chat_run_check1

functions.name: check_citation_source
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zhiqing_rag.check_citation_source()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    PERFORM c.id FROM zhiqing_rag.document_chunk c
    JOIN zhiqing_rag.document d ON d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.id=c.document_id
    WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND c.id=NEW.source_chunk_id
      AND c.document_id=NEW.document_id AND c.revision_id=NEW.revision_id
      AND c.generation_id=NEW.source_generation_id AND c.content_sha256=NEW.content_sha256
      AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.active_generation_id=c.generation_id
    FOR KEY SHARE OF c;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Citation does not match active source chunk' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zhiqing_rag.guard_evaluation_run_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (NEW.tenant_id,NEW.dataset_id,NEW.dataset_sha256,NEW.code_revision,NEW.config_snapshot,NEW.total_cases)
       IS DISTINCT FROM
       (OLD.tenant_id,OLD.dataset_id,OLD.dataset_sha256,OLD.code_revision,OLD.config_snapshot,OLD.total_cases) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evaluation run snapshot is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: guard_frozen_dataset
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zhiqing_rag.guard_frozen_dataset()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.status <> 'DRAFT' AND (
        NEW.status='DRAFT' OR
        (NEW.tenant_id,NEW.kb_id,NEW.code,NEW.version,NEW.dataset_sha256,NEW.frozen_at)
        IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.tenant_id,OLD.kb_id,OLD.code,OLD.version,OLD.dataset_sha256,OLD.frozen_at)
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Frozen dataset identity/content hash is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
